entities.name: the wharf road along the north bank of the 汴河 (S2's route)
entities.what: The walk along the canal's north bank from the Rainbow Bridge's north foot to the 望楼饭铺 sheds: a narrow strip between the shop fronts and the moored boats in the west, the trackers' open bank, the strip in front of the gateway and the long house, through the riverside dining terrace, past the open-air eatery and across the wide unloading yard, then along the narrow bank in front of the scaffolded building and the long halls, past the great willow and the jetty, through the grain porters' wharf and along the long shed's front to the countryside.
entities.vis: part: hidden behind the moored boats at u 20900-21700 and 25450-26600, and through the terrace (u 22920-23500)
entities.note: DATUM AND SEAMS: point 0 is S3's route point at exactly u 20500, (20500,258) est, copied from gen/map/S3/parts/structures_w.json with its edges (edge_n 215, edge_s 280). The last point is exactly u 29050: (29050,730), S1's datum: the open ground in front of the 望楼饭铺 shed's east end, just south of the rider's animal (hooves v ~690, t12); bare open ground runs on east at v ~650-860 in front of S1's stalls. EDGES: edge_n is where the open ground stops at building fronts, walls, fences, stalls and tables; edge_s is the river agents' bank_top (the level ground's edge nearest the water: river_w 20500-21850, river_m 23300-26000, river_e 26000-28900), copied at my stations; between 21850 and 23300 river_w2's part had not landed, so edge_s there is my est (t3: shore v ~470-500). No road edge is drawn anywhere. WEST (20500-21750): a strip only 25-65 px of v deep between the shop fronts and fences (v 100-141) and the moored boats (bank_top behind them, v 162-232). TRACKERS' BANK (21750-22300): the centre follows the trackers' towpath diagonal (their feet run (21867,235)->(22172,386)) and passes south of the split willow's feet ((22225,290), (22345,318), t3); river_w puts the bank_top at (21850,248) and the trackers on the top of the wash slope: river_w2's bank line decides edge_s here.
